name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: A sidebar that folds to icons on desktop and opens as a sheet below 768px. Ctrl+B or Cmd+B toggles it.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <main data-slot="sidebar-inset" :class="cn('relative flex min-w-0 w-full flex-1 flex-col bg-background', props.class)">
    <slot />
  </main>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { sidebarMenuButtonVariants } from ".";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ as?: string | Component; isActive?: boolean; class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), { as: "a" });
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="props.as"
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
    data-focus-inset=""
    :data-active="props.isActive ? '' : undefined"
    :aria-current="props.isActive ? 'page' : undefined"
    :type="props.as === 'button' ? 'button' : undefined"
    :class="cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants(), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { sidebarMenuSubButtonVariants } from ".";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ as?: string | Component; isActive?: boolean; class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), { as: "a" });
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="props.as"
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-sub-button"
    data-focus-inset=""
    :data-active="props.isActive ? '' : undefined"
    :aria-current="props.isActive ? 'page' : undefined"
    :type="props.as === 'button' ? 'button' : undefined"
    :class="cn(sidebarMenuSubButtonVariants(), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </component>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <hr data-slot="sidebar-separator" :class="cn('mx-2 my-0 border-0 border-t border-sidebar-border', props.class)">
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { PanelLeftIcon } from "@lucide/vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useSidebar } from "./utils";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();
const { isMobile, open, openMobile, toggle } = useSidebar();
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    data-slot="sidebar-trigger"
    aria-label="Toggle sidebar"
    aria-keyshortcuts="Control+B Meta+B"
    :aria-expanded="isMobile ? openMobile : open"
    :class="cn('inline-flex size-7 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground active:scale-97 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 [&_svg]:size-4', props.class)"
    @click="toggle"
  >
    <PanelLeftIcon aria-hidden="true" class="rtl:rotate-180" />
  </button>
</template>
